about: Classification eval for the prompt path (spec §8). Each case is a real prompt with the capability and difficulty band we expect the CLASSIFIER to produce. These are the only trustworthy signals here because they are real engine outputs from a real classifier. difficulty bands: easy=1-2, medium=3, hard=4-5. accept_capabilities lists acceptable classifications when a prompt legitimately straddles two. NOTE: there is deliberately no 'model tier' label — the engine has no small/mid/flagship concept; it ranks by measured quality/cost/latency. Routing is not scored here (see routing invariants in run_eval.sh, and rank_test.go/ceiling_test.go for ranking logic). Real routing quality requires real measured benchmarks.
